In the context of Christian tradition, Allana is associated with the Virgin Mary, who is often depicted as a green or verdant figure, symbolizing eternal life and spiritual growth. The name Allana is also linked to the concept of 'all-ness', implying completeness or wholeness. In modern times, the name Allana has gained popularity as a shortened form of names such as Alexandra or Allison, and is often associated with qualities such as kindness, gentleness, and a strong sense of justice.
